FIFA Club World Cup 2026 to Bring Late-Night Celebrations to Maharashtra

The state of Maharashtra has allowed hotels and restaurants to stay open until 4 AM for the FIFA Club World Cup 2026 final screening, which is scheduled to take place in December. This decision aims to accommodate fans who want to watch the event live. The move is seen as a way to boost local businesses during the tournament.
